jobs.occupation: Senior CAMO Engineer (Helicopters) (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
The benefits of applying to work with us

Look forward to an exciting and challenging mix of responsibilities while playing an active role in shaping a wide range of projects and initiatives. We offer you the opportunity to work independently and grow through diverse challenges. You can also expect a seamless career transition from physical hangar operations to a strategic, high-impact technical office role.
What you'll be doing
✓ Ensure the continuing airworthiness of the fleet in accordance with EASA Part-CAMO requirements✓ Manage and optimize Aircraft Maintenance Programs and maintenance planning activities✓ Evaluate and implement airworthiness requirements, including  Airworthiness Directives (ADs), Service Bulletins (SBs), and engineering changes (STC, MiC)✓ Maintain aircraft configuration control and the integrity of technical records✓ Act as the technical focal point between CAMO, maintenance organizations, flight operations, and aviation authorities✓ Support compliance, audits, and continuous improvement while providing technical guidance on complex maintenance matters

What sets you apart
✓ Bachelor's degree in Aeronautical/Aerospace Engineering or a related technical discipline, or a valid EASA Part-66 B1.3 and/or B2 license with relevant professional experience✓ Several years of experience in Continuing Airworthiness (Part-CAMO) and/or Part-145 helicopter maintenance, with a solid understanding of EASA regulations✓ Strong technical knowledge of helicopter systems; experience with Airbus Helicopters (H135, H145, AS350) is preferred, while experience with Bell 206/407 or AW109 aircraft is considered an asset✓ Experience in managing Aircraft Maintenance Programmes (AMP), Airworthiness Directives (AD), Service Bulletins (SB), Modifications (ICA`s  of STC, MiC), and aircraft configuration and airworthiness management✓ Proficiency in LTB400 or a comparable aviation maintenance management system, with confidence in working with technical documentation and records✓ Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken

Accelerate your career.
Our mission at Controlling and Finance Assurance (CF A) is to provide objective, factual and independent foresight to help Siemens be excellent and to improve the overall success of the company. As a business partner to Siemens’ management, we apply our expertise in a wide range of topics to create organizational impact. Collaborative ecosystems help create and use innovative methods for better assurance. We offer an inspiring, diverse and inclusive environment for our people to develop professionally and personally. Our core values, being respectful, curious, humble and open, define how we work together as a department.
As Siemens is creating technology to transform the everyday for everyone, the Technology & Financial Audit Practice plays a pivotal role in providing assurance to the Managing Board and the Audit Committee. We cover a wide range of technology and finance-related global audit topics such as assurance over entire digital ecosystems, AI and data governance, SW development, major IT transformations, customer project execution, organizational maturity at small / mid-size entities, sustainability reporting or new digital products and business models.
To deliver on our vision of being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, CF A offers a unique Grow and Development Model. We believe int the concept of lifelong learning and therefore encourage our people towards a mindset where continuous upskilling and reskilling becomes a natural part of our career. We invest in our expertise and therefore provide continuous career coaching, trainings and mentoring, all whilst working with top Siemens business leaders on multiple high-profile projects around the world. This is your chance to build your network within the company and become part of a truly international and innovative team.
To solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is your place to thrive, challenge the status quo, make a difference and grow in a team of pioneers who share your passion for technology.
Discover more about CF A: Siemens Controlling and Finance Assurance (https://assets.new.siemens.com/siemens/assets/api/uuid:832d2c5d-e30c-4163-a1be-9fa3d67f645b/controlling-and-finance-assurance-info-for-applicants.pdf)

What part will you play?

- Identify key risks related to Siemens’s AI activities – in internal processes as well as in our products, covering technical, operational, contractual and regulatory aspects.- Support the continuous evolution of AI governance at Siemens.- Design and execute comprehensive audit programs and controls to address the identified risks.- Enhance and challenge existing audit techniques, e.g. by driving the responsible and effective use of AI in audit and lifting the potential from automation and data analytics.- Independently drive assurance objectives, define and align conclusions and recommended improvements to implement change (as necessary) in the organization.- Drive meetings with auditees and key stakeholders to present the team’s conclusions and recommended improvements.- Actively contribute to shaping the future of audit in the age of AI.- Build and maintain your network in various Siemens businesses and functions.- Conduct your audit engagements using CF A’s Agile Audit Framework.

What you need to make real what matters.

- Proven track record of career development including several years of professional experience within Siemens, or a technology company, or a respected assurance and consulting firm.- Strong academic history with a degree (Master or Ph.D.) in AI, data science, statistics, economics or related fields.- A passion for getting AI right, i.e. facilitating innovation and speed responsibly.- Deep expertise and hands-on experience with at least one of the following areas:- Developing AI solutions in different configurations (training ML models, utilizing foundation models, monitoring them in production), ideally in industrial settings, critical infrastructure or financial services.- Testing or certifying AI systems, devising AI governance, formulating technical standards for AI in industrial settings.
- Experience with AI deployments in the cloud.- Understanding of IT risk management (e.g., IAM, DR/BC) and assurance principles.- Certifications like ISACA AI Audit or IAPP AI Governance Professional are a plus.- Strong desire and drive to develop into a business or functional role after 3-5 years in audit.- Excellent communication skills to summarize and describe technical audit results for senior stakeholders.- Proficiency in English, flexibility to travel (up to 30%, incl. international travel) and embracing our hybrid working model is essential.

What we offer.

- A hybrid working model comprising 2 to 3 days of working from the office per week- Attractive remuneration package and relocation (if needed)- CF A Grow & Development program for both professional and personal growth- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for you and your family- Find more benefits here (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs.html)

FACILITIES MANAGER EUROPE (F/M/D)

At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop regulated technology that helps unlock better evidence and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Our software platforms support clinical trials, diagnostics, and medical decision?making in highly controlled regulatory environments.

As Facilities Manager Europe (f/m/d), you will support Clario's facilities across Europe with a focus on our office in Estenfeld, Germany.

WHAT WE OFFER

*
Competitive compensation.

*
Flexible working hours and working time accounts to support the work-life balance.

*
Hybrid work model, allowing for 1-2 days of remote work after the probation period.

*
Support your professional development through internal and external training and certification programs.

*
Attractive benefits (security, flexibility, support and well-being).

*
Engaging employee programs.

WHAT YOU´LL BE DOING

*
Facilities Operations: Providing overall facilities support by ensuring the seamless delivery of facility operations, building management, structural measures, maintenance teams, housekeeping, reception, cafeteria operations, asset management, visitor management, and security & safety protocols. Clario's primary European facilities are situated in Germany, Hungary, Belgium, Switzerland, and Turkey.

*
Facility Layout Standards and Compliance: Supporting facility layout standards for electrical systems, HVAC, IT infrastructure (phones, conference systems, displays), materials, access control and more. Collaborating with local contractors/vendors/departments to manage these processes through to completion, ensuring compliance with local and state building codes.

*
Site Coordination: Managing and coordinating the logistics involved in opening, relocating, or closing a facility, including security systems, access control, furniture, signage, showroom/marketing requirements, telecommunications, and more.

*
Budgeting and Capital Expenditure: Actively participating in the capital expenditure budgeting process and managing purchasing requests for facility needs. Accurately forecasting and preparing facility-related budgets. Conducting financial and business analysis, including preparing reports on expenditures, savings, and areas for cost optimization.

*
Compliance and Standards Development: Ensuring all facilities are operated and maintained in compliance with local, state, and national laws, company standards, and procedures. Responsible for developing and refining standards as business needs evolve, including ensuring annual occupational safety and fire inspections where applicable.

*
Stakeholder and Management Communication: Maintaining a dotted line to the local management teams, participating in and reporting at management meetings. Building strong relationships with key business stakeholders by collecting feedback and delivering reports on business-critical aspects, such as occupancy, site launches, and facility improvements and audits.

*
External Relations and First Point of Contact: Serving as the First Point of Contact for the landlord, labor inspectorate, municipalities, authorities, and occupational safety departments.

*
Vendor and Contractor Management: Building and maintaining strong relationships with local building management and managing third-party contractors/vendors responsible for facility maintenance and operations. This includes monitoring tasks completed, overseeing technical acceptance, and approving invoices.

*
Lease and Contract Management: Managing leases and facility agreements, including understanding legal terms and commercial contract structures. Ensuring contracts are renewed and negotiated in a timely manner.

*
Sustainability and Energy Efficiency: Supporting sustainability initiatives by tracking, reporting, and working towards reducing emissions and waste across facility operations. Implementing energy-saving initiatives, including tracking energy consumption and suggesting areas for improvement.

*
Crisis and Emergency Management: Developing and maintaining emergency response plans for the facility, including fire drills, evacuation procedures, and pandemic-related safety measures.

*
Training and Development: Coordinating safety and facility-related training for employees to ensure everyone is aware of evacuation procedures, safety protocols, and proper usage of shared resources like conference rooms, equipment, and storage areas.

*
Team Collaboration and Support: Contributing to team success by assisting colleagues in resolving internal issues and supporting shared goals.

*
Quality and Standards Management: Ensuring adherence to organizational SOPs by regularly reviewing and understanding operational guidelines. Supporting the establishment and enforcement of departmental standards to maintain consistent quality service.

*
Technical and Industry Development: Enhancing expertise through active participation in company-sponsored training programs and maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation and informed decision-making.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

*
Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management or a comparable degree with a technical background, alongside additional business management training or further development.

*
Five or more years of experience in facilities management or an equivalent role, including proven experience in managing technical building projects.

*
Fluent language skills in both German and English are required. Additional language skills are beneficial.

*
Organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet established schedules, timelines, or deadlines.

*
Creative problem-solving skills with strong project management abilities.

*
Proficiency in working with computer software, including the MS Office suite.

*
Ability to influence others without direct authority.

*
Strong ability to adapt to changing priorities.

*
A strong desire to succeed while maintaining a professional and positive attitude.

*
Flexibility to travel to our European sites as needed, typically averaging two trips per year.

At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.
Ansprechpartner
Sebastian Braun

Your creative fieldWe are looking for a full-time, permanent Brand Manager (all genders) to start as soon as possible . We live remote-first within Germany , but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.

As our new Brand Manager, you'll have responsibility of one of the most impactful projects currently running at Contabo: our brand. With 250,000+ customers worldwide and a strong reputation in developer and infrastructure communities, we're now transitioning from a VPS-focused positioning toward becoming Europe's AI Cloud Inference Provider.

The groundwork is done: strategy set, agency engaged, direction clear. What we need now is someone who takes ownership of the execution. That means running the agency relationship, driving the messaging architecture for both product identities, and making sure the rollout actually happens - across the website, product UI, API docs, email, paid, social. All of it and consistently.

You'll manage the branding agency end-to-end briefings, feedback rounds, milestone tracking, sign-offs and develop the messaging architecture and tone of voice for both product lines. That includes creating brand guidelines, design tokens, and all the rollout-ready assets that come with it. From there, you drive the actual rollout across every customer-facing touchpoint: website, product UI, API docs, email, paid media, social.

You brief and quality-control content output from internal and external contributors, keep the PR story pipeline moving together with our PR Manager, and set up brand tracking across Peec.ai, GA4, sentiment, and Share of Voice - reporting results directly to the Head of Creative Marketing and the CMO. As we continue to expand into EU, US, and LATAM markets, you're also the one making sure brand consistency and localization stay on track.

You'll report directly to the Head of Creative Marketing in the CMO organization and work closely with Product, Support, SEO/GAIO, and PR - without having direct authority over those teams. Strong stakeholder management is therefore a core part of making this work.

What convinces usYour personality, paired with:

Must have:
• Proven experience developing brand strategy and identity - verbal and visual - from brief through to delivery
• Track record managing external agency relationships end-to-end (briefings, feedback rounds, sign-offs)
• Real familiarity with B2B / B2C tech audiences, particularly developers and infrastructure engineers - not surface-level, but you know how they think and what they dismiss immediately
• Project management across cross-functional teams: milestone tracking, stakeholder alignment, the coordination that doesn't show up in the final deck but determines whether the final deck ever gets implemented
• 5+ years in brand management or brand strategy, with meaningful time in B2B tech, SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or developer-focused products
• English C1/C2 (working language) and German B2+, other EU languages are a plus

Should have:
• Experience with brand tracking and measurement – sentiment, Share of Voice, brand recall surveys; you've used data to make a concrete decision, not just reported it
• Hands-on with tools like Peec.ai or Brand24, GA4, Figma, Confluence/Jira, and at least one CMS
• AI usage fluency

Nice to have:
• SEO and content strategy fundamentals; understanding of GAIO/LLM visibility is a real advantage here
• Experience in a PE-backed or VC-backed environment where ownership is high and process guardrails are limited
• Spanish or Portuguese

We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.

Awesome ProspectsAt Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:
• Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
• Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
• Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
• Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
• Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
• Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
• Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
• Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
• Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
• Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
• Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget

How to reach usIf you have any questions, you can reach out to Alina by email at alina.peissl@contabo.de.

Serco is an international provider of services to governments and public organisations, operating across sectors where delivery, public confidence and reputation matter. In Europe, Serco works through both established Serco operations and specialist local businesses, combining international capability with a strong understanding of national requirements and operating environments.

European Homecare (EHC) in Germany and ORS in Switzerland are part of Serco and provide immigration and social care services in their respective markets. Each business has its own history, identity, workforce and stakeholder environment. Communications must therefore be locally relevant and sensitive to the nature of the services delivered, while supporting closer alignment with Serco’s standards, values, channels and wider European direction.

The European Communications team supports operations across 10 countries, four sectors and five languages. It provides strategic advice, shared standards and specialist support across internal communications, media relations, issues and crisis communications, digital content and reputation. This role is the senior local communications lead for EHC in Germany and leads internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, while working as an integral member of the European Communications team.

The postholder will have the autonomy to shape and deliver communications locally, working closely with local leaders and drawing on the expertise and support of the European Communications team. The role calls for sound judgement, curiosity and a practical approach to strengthening employee understanding, engagement and reputation as EHC and ORS continue their journey within Serco.

Key purpose  

- Lead communications for EHC in Germany across internal and external channels, ensuring communications are accurate, relevant and appropriate for a sensitive public-service environment.
- Own internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, helping leaders keep employees informed, engaged and connected to local priorities and Serco’s wider direction.
- Act as a trusted communications adviser to the EHC and ORS leadership teams, providing clear, practical and well-judged counsel, including in complex, sensitive or fast-moving situations.
- Build strong networks across the local businesses and Serco Europe, connecting people, expertise and information so communications are coordinated and effective.
- Support the continued integration of EHC and ORS within Serco, respecting their local identities while embedding Serco’s communications standards, governance, channels and values.

Structure and reporting relationship 

The role reports to the Customer Relations (CR) & Operations Director Switzerland. The postholder is also a core member of the European Communications team and works closely with the Director of Communications, Marketing and Public Affairs Europe and European Communications colleagues on priorities, standards, governance and delivery. The role operates with a high degree of independence and works closely with EHC leadership in Germany and ORS leadership in Switzerland.  

Internal Communications

- Own and deliver the internal communications plans for EHC in Germany and ORS in Switzerland, including print and digital newsletters, leadership updates, employee announcements, change communications and internal campaigns, working closely with local leaders and the European Communications team.
- Draft and distribute newsletters; act as an internal correspondent to identify and write impactful stories.
- Lead employee engagement initiatives aligned with Serco’s values and business priorities.
- Develop and maintain content for internal platforms.  

External Communications

- Lead day-to-day media relations in Germany and preferably Switzerland, including media monitoring, handling enquiries, preparing spokespeople and coordinating responses with European Communications colleagues when required.
- Lead local issues management and crisis communications preparedness, providing calm, practical and well-judged advice to leaders in sensitive or difficult situations.
- Produce clear written and visual content for external channels, including social media, in line with European Communications standards and priorities.
- Manage the German-speaking  website of Immigration Europe and related external digital content for Germany and Switzerland, in line with European Communications standards and approvals.

Integration Communications

- Contribute to integration plans following recent acquisitions, ensuring employees and stakeholders are informed and engaged.
- Apply strong change communications judgement, identifying how different audiences may respond to change and adapting messages, channels and engagement approaches to their needs and sensitivities.

Social Media & Content Creation

- Collaborate with the European communications team to source, create, and promote content that showcases services, people, and impact.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build and sustain trusted relationships across operations, HR, corporate functions and leadership teams, creating effective networks within EHC in Germany, ORS in Switzerland and the wider European business.
- Represent the European Communications function locally. jobs.description:
AURELIUS is a global alternative investor, distinguished and widely recognised for its operational approach. It focuses on private markets, in particular Private Equity and Private Debt. Its key investment platforms include AURELIUS Opportunities V, AURELIUS European Opportunities IV, AUR Portfolio III and AURELIUS Growth (Wachstumskapital). AURELIUS has been growing significantly in recent years, especially expanding its global footprint, and today employs more than 400 professionals in 10 offices spanning Europe, North America and Asia.

AURELIUS is driven by a spirit of entrepreneurship, with a collegiate, hands-on approach to complex projects. We are motivated, open, fun, and operate as a team of equals.

Create impact with passion!

For an AURELIUS’ portfolio company located in Bavaria we are looking for a

Head of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d)

As a Head of PMO you will lead and professionalize the end-to-end Project Management / Delivery function across the EMEA utilities business, spanning residential and industrial energy tech, software, and analytics solutions. You will own delivery from project definition through mass production and customer rollout, integrating Sales, Product Management, R&D, NPI, Procurement, and Quality into one disciplined execution engine. Furthermore, you will transform a currently fragmented, product- and site-centric delivery model into a standardized, cross-BU project delivery organization with clear stage gates, transparent KPIs, and predictable outcomes. The Head of PMO will act as the single accountable owner like a “project CEO” for on-time, on-quality, and on-cost delivery of projects and new product introductions, and as the primary interface to major customers for delivery commitments. Your task is to drive execution discipline, cost control, and margin protection across the full project lifecycle. The role requires frequent travel.

Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery Leadership & Organizational Ownership

- Lead and develop the EMEA Project Delivery organization across customer projects, NPI, and cross-BU solution programs
- Define and implement the organizational setup, governance model, and PM career path, including near-/offshore delivery capacity
- Build a balanced delivery organization combining hardware project management, software/solution delivery, and NPI program management
- Ensure scalability, agility, and clear accountability across all delivery units and sites

2. End-to-End Engineering Delivery

- Own end-to-end delivery from project definition through development, industrialization, mass production ramp, and customer handover
- Act as the single point of accountability for on-time, on-quality, on-cost execution of customer projects and NPIs
- Drive execution discipline, cost control, and scalable delivery models across multi-site and multi-BU programs
- Establish a common project lifecycle, stage-gate framework, and PMO standards applied consistently across electricity, gas, thermal, software, and analytics
- Ensure robust project planning, risk management, change control, and claim management on all major programs
- Chair stage-gate reviews and enforce go/no-go decisions against scope, schedule, cost, quality, and business case

3. Cross-BU Solution Delivery (HW + SW + Analytics)

- Lead delivery of integrated solutions combining residential and industrial meters, head-end software, and analytics offerings
- Break down BU silos and orchestrate cross-BU program teams around customer outcomes, not product lines
- Establish shared solution architectures and reusable delivery playbooks across product families
- Ensure consistent solution scoping, pricing input, and delivery commitments across the portfolio

4. NPI & Industrialization

- Collaborate with Operations on NPI program management from early involvement design, to design freeze through pilot, ramp, and stable serial production
- Ensure early and structured involvement of NPI, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality in R&D projects
- Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-cost, and design-for-serviceability discipline into every new program
- Manage ramp readiness: supply readiness, test coverage, production line qualification, and yield curves

5. Cross-functional Collaboration

- Act as the delivery counterpart to Product Management (portfolio & roadmap) and R&D (technology execution)
- Partner with Sales and Customer Projects to translate customer commitments into feasible, margin-protected delivery plans
- Provide delivery input into bids, contract negotiation, and commercial terms (milestones, LDs, acceptance criteria)
- Collaborate with Procurement and SCM to secure supply, lead times, and cost targets for project ramp
- Collaborate with Quality to embed quality gates and field-performance feedback into delivery governance
- Align with Finance on project controlling, revenue recognition, milestone billing, and cash collection

6. Financial & Resource Management

- Own the project delivery cost base and the aggregated margin performance of the project portfolio
- Drive project margin protection: budget adherence, contingency management, scope and change control
- Optimize allocation of PM and delivery resources across customer projects and NPI programs
- Drive build vs. buy vs. outsource decisions for delivery capacity, balancing control, cost, and flexibility
- Support business cases and mid-term planning with realistic delivery assumptions and risk-adjusted estimates

7. Transformation & Change Leadership

- Lead transformation initiatives to increase delivery productivity, reduce time-to-market, and improve predictability
- Standardize and digitalize PMO tooling (planning, reporting, risk, resource management)
- Build a high-performance, accountable, and customer-centric delivery culture
- Drive upskilling and certification of the PM community across hardware, software, and solution delivery

8. Governance, Risk & Compliance

- Ensure project delivery complies with contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, and quality requirements
- Establish transparent portfolio reporting to the CEO and executive team, including early warning on at-risk programs
- Own risk register for the delivery portfolio and drive systematic mitigation

Your Profile

Professional Experience

- Minimum 15+ years of experience in project, program, and delivery leadership, including senior roles (VP/SVP level) in an international, matrix organization
- Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional delivery organizations spanning hardware, software, and integrated solutions
- Significant experience in customer project delivery in a B2B environment (preferably utilities, energy, industrial technology, or telecom infrastructure)
- Strong NPI and industrialization background: bringing new hardware and software products from development into serial production and customer rollout
- Demonstrated success in owning end-to-end delivery from project definition to mass production and customer acceptance
- Experience running structured stage-gate and PMO frameworks at scale, with measurable improvements in OTD, margin, and predictability
- Solid commercial acumen: contract, bid, and claim management; project P&L ownership; milestone billing and working capital control
- Experience in driving organizational transformation and productivity improvements (cost, efficiency, time-to-market)
- Experience in global/multi-site setups, including near-/offshore delivery structures
- Exposure to carve-out, integration, or major transformation programs (strong plus)

Intercultural Experience

- Proven leadership experience in international and cross-cultural environments, managing teams across multiple geographies
- Strong experience in navigating matrix organizations and global governance structures
- High level of cultural awareness, adaptability, and communication effectiveness at executive and customer level
- Fluency in German and English is a prerequisite

Personal attributes

- University degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
- Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus; recognized PM certifications (PMP, IPMA, PgMP, SAFe) are a plus
- Strong technical understanding across hardware, embedded systems, software, and cloud/analytics solutions — able to challenge and steer technical trade-offs
- Deep mastery of project and program management methods, stage-gate governance, and modern delivery models (Agile at scale, hybrid HW/SW delivery)
- Proven ability to drive execution at scale in multi-site, distributed delivery organizations, including vendor and outsourcing management
- Data-driven delivery mindset: use of KPIs, portfolio dashboards, and analytics to improve OTD, quality, and productivity
- Strong business and P&L awareness, with ability to protect and expand project margin under commercial pressure
- Ability to connect customer commitments, technical execution, and financial outcomes
- Strong ROI orientation: able to challenge scope, prioritize based on value, and terminate programs that no longer meet hurdle rates
- Strong decision-making capability under ambiguity, especially in evolving organizational and carve-out setups
- Excellent stakeholder management skills across CEO / board level, customers, suppliers, and internal functions
- High degree of resilience and change leadership capability in transformation environments
- Ability to attract, develop, and retain top program and delivery talent

As a Data Analyst (f/m/d), you will support the Process Digitalization Team for Grid Technologies within Siemens Energy. Your focus will be on transforming scalable data into actionable insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and sustainable business growth. By analyzing complex datasets and translating business requirements into analytical solutions, you will drive cross-functional data and analytics initiatives that enhance competitiveness and support the future development of our products and processes. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Conducting in-depth analyses of manufacturing and operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement across the business area
* Supporting the definition, development, and continuous refinement of data structures and data products, with a focus on data quality, consistency, and usability
* Collaboration with data engineering and cloud architecture teams to ensure analytical requirements are reflected in data ingestion processes, data models, and platform capabilities
* Development and maintenance of dashboards, KPIs, reports, and lightweight analytical applications to increase transparency and support data-driven decision-making
* Continuous evaluation and optimization of analytical workflows, performance metrics, and reporting processes to enhance operational efficiency and business value creation
* Provision of actionable insights and analytical recommendations to support strategic initiatives, operational excellence, and the adoption of data-driven practices across the organization

What You Bring
* Academic degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable field, combined with professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data-driven process optimization
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including hands-on experience with modern data and analytics tools such as Snowflake, dbt Cloud, Alteryx, Python, and SQL
* Expertise in the development of dashboards, KPI frameworks, reporting solutions, and data visualizations using leading business intelligence platforms such as Power BI and Tableau
* Solid understanding of cloud-based data ecosystems, preferably Snowflake and AWS, as well as modern data stack concepts including ELT processes and data modeling
* Ability to transform complex datasets into clear insights, actionable recommendations, and decision-relevant information for stakeholders across all organizational levels
* Business fluency in English, strong communication and stakeholder management skills, an international mindset and willingness to travel internationally

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Data Engineer (f/m/d) in our Enterprise Data Office of the TI STG Organization, you will develop and maintain robust data pipelines and ETL processes supporting STG’s digital platforms, while collaborating closely with architects and data stewards to ensure high standards of data quality and governance. In this role, you will optimize data workflows to enable advanced analytics, AI, and Digital Twin use cases, proactively monitor and resolve data integration issues across multiple systems, and work hand in hand with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and future-ready data solutions.

Your work will enable scalable, secure, and high-quality data solutions that power initiatives like Digital Twins, predictive analytics, and process optimization.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Design and implement robust data pipelines for structured and unstructured data
* Ensure data availability and integrity for critical business applications and analytics
* Support integration of core systems (ERP, PLM, SCM) into the data platform
* Enable AI and advanced analytics by providing clean, well-modeled datasets and drive automation and performance improvements in data workflows
* Contribute to the development of STG’s data architecture and governance framework
* Collaborate with architects on cloud-based solutions and modern data architectures

What You Bring

* University Degree or similar education as well as several years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, and data integration
* Strong skills in SQL and experience with big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop) combined with knowledge of data modeling, data governance, and best practices for data quality
* Hands-on experience with cloud-based data architectures and data lake architectures; experience with AWS and Snowflake are a plus
* Experience with Alteryx and Python or similar programming languages for data processing
* Familiarity with API integration and event-driven architectures, experience with MLOps and enabling AI/ML pipelines would be a plus
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken

About the Team

In our Transformation of Industry division, we offer comprehensive digital portfolio solutions in the oil and gas sector and other process industries comprising rotating equipment, electrification, and solutions for the Subsea business. Our customers are supported with sustainable and mission-critical products, solutions, and services.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder

jobs.employer_name: Universitätsklinikum der Technischen Universität München AöR
jobs.description:
Postdoc (m/f/d) – Translational Cancer Research | Gastroenterology 

Full- or part-time | temporary (36 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für Innere Medizin II, Gastroenterologie

The Department of Internal Medicine II at TUM Klinikum rechts der Isar is recruiting a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our newly established Max Eder Research Group.

Our research aims to decipher the molecular mechanisms of tumor evolution, cellular plasticity, and therapy resistance in gastric and gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (GEAC). By integrating longitudinal patient samples from prospective clinical trials with cutting-edge multi-omics technologies and functional model systems, our group is committed to understanding the biological mechanisms underlying treatment resistance in upper gastrointestinal cancers and translating these discoveries into novel therapeutic strategies.

The position offers the unique opportunity to work at the interface of clinical oncology, cancer genomics, computational biology, and functional cancer research within an outstanding translational research environment.

Your responsibilities:

You will investigate the molecular mechanisms of tumor evolution, cellular plasticity, and therapy resistance in GEAC through the integration of longitudinal multi-omics datasets from prospective clinical trial samples. 

Your research will focus on computational analysis and interpretation of large-scale molecular datasets, including:

- Analysis and integration of single-cell and spatial transcriptomic datasets to characterize tumor evolution and treatment response
- Inference of tissue-specific gene expression and tumor activity from plasma cell-free DNA fragmentation patterns
- Development of computational approaches for the integration of genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic and immune profiling data
- Multi-omics integration to reconstruct tumor evolutionary trajectories and characterize cellular plasticity during treatment
- Development and implementation of bioinformatic pipelines for high-dimensional sequencing datasets
- Close collaboration with clinicians, biologists, computational biologists and international collaborators
- Presentation of research at international conferences and publication in high-impact scientific journals

Your profile:

We are seeking an ambitious computational scientist with a strong interest in translational cancer research and multi-omics data analysis.

Required qualifications

- PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Sciences, Cancer Genomics or a related quantitative discipline
- Strong experience in the analysis of next-generation sequencing data (e.g. transcriptomic and/or genomic datasets)
- Excellent programming skills in R and/or Python
- Experience working in Linux/Unix environments and using reproducible computational workflows
- Ability to independently design and drive scientific projects
- Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English

Preferred qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

- Cell-free DNA sequencing and fragmentation analysis (highly desirable)
- Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis and/or Spatial transcriptomics
- Multi-omics integration
- Machine learning or statistical modelling of biological datasets
- Cancer genomics and tumor evolution

We offer you:

- A postdoctoral position within a newly established and rapidly growing Max Eder Research Group funded by the German Cancer Aid
- An outstanding translational research environment embedded within TUM Klinikum rechts der Isar, one of Europe’s leading academic medical centers
- Close collaboration with internationally renowned research groups at the Institute of Cancer Research (ICR), Sutton, UK, and Chalmers University of Technology, Gothenburg, Sweden, including opportunities for scientific exchange and short-term research stays at both partner institutions.
- Direct integration with prospective clinical trials and longitudinal patient cohorts
- Close collaboration with physicians, computational biologists and internationally recognized research partners
- Strong mentorship and excellent opportunities for scientific independence and career development
- Support for national and international conference attendance
- Competitive salary according to TV-L
- EGYM Wellpass, corporate benefits, company pension scheme (VBL), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers
- Modern workplace in the heart of Munich with excellent public transport connections

We look forward to your application!
